resources.string: If you lose this phone and have no copy of this key, no one, not even us, can get your identity back. Save it in at least one way, somewhere only you can reach. Boson Identity can keep it too: choose \"I already have one\" there and bring in this backup.
Copied. The clipboard is cleared in %1$d seconds.
This device doesn\'t hold an identity key.
Your private key as a QR code
Anyone with this key can act as you. Never send it to anyone, and never type it into a website.
Camera permission is needed to scan the QR.
From the copy you saved, type these two groups of four characters. Each row of the key starts with the number of its first group.
That doesn\'t match. Check your copy, or look at the key again.
This phone needs your identity\'s key. Get it from a device that has it, or from your backup.
How people see you. You can change it any time.
Couldn\'t create your account; please try again
That identity is already taken; please try again
Invalid Server ID (expected a Boson node id)
That QR code is not a valid super node code
No new identity is being made. Start again.
No user identity on this device
This node doesn\'t accept new accounts from apps. Choose another node.
This identity isn\'t registered on this node. Choose its home node; Boson Identity shows it.
The request was turned down on the other device.
The code expired before it was approved.
No pairing is in progress. Show a new code.
Couldn\'t complete the security check in time; please try again
Couldn\'t verify the security check; please try again
Registration was rejected; please try again
Couldn\'t establish a secure connection. If this server uses a self-signed certificate, enter its Server ID under Advanced options.
Choose the node your identity is registered with. Boson Identity shows its code: open your identity there and tap its home node.
Your home node is a super node that keeps your account and passes your messages on. Scan its code, or enter its address.
Use the key you saved: its file, its QR code, or its text.
Its key was made on this phone, and nobody else has it. Next, save a copy: if you lose this phone without one, no one can bring your identity back.
On a device that has your identity, scan this code: in Boson Identity, open Devices and approve; in Photon, open Settings, then Devices, and approve.
The code expired before it was approved.
The code works for three minutes, only on your identity\'s home node.
Your account is protected by a passphrase. Enter it to register this device.
Point the camera at the QR code of your key, from your backup or another device.
Scan the home node\'s code, shown by Boson Identity or by the node\'s portal.
Point your camera at the QR code from the super node portal to fill in its address automatically.
Scan the super node QR code
Boson node id (for a self-signed server)
Required to trust a self-signed HTTPS server; leave blank for a public CA.
Running a one-time security check on this device. This can take a few seconds, and the time varies from run to run.
Sign in to an existing account
Open your key file, scan your key\'s QR code, or type it in.
Show a code here, and scan it with Boson Identity, or with Photon on another device.
Photon is yours through a Boson identity: a key that is you on the Boson network, kept on your phone, not by a company.
